title: Aspen Search arrow pair
description: Two 60px-tall square arrow buttons split by a hairline, for stepping through slides; on hover an ink fill rises behind the arrow (0.8s, expo out) and the arrow turns paper-coloured.
notes: needs onPrev/onNext from a parent that holds the slide state; CSS-only hover
name: aspensearch-arrows

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of the left arrow, e.g. "Previous"

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of the right arrow, e.g. "Next"

props.name: prevDisabled
props.description: greys out the left arrow (at the start of a list)

props.name: nextDisabled
props.description: greys out the right arrow (at the end of a list)
